CustomField.description: The exact Lead.Status value this qualification policy governs. Held here so Lead_Inbound_Before_Save can ask whether the stage being entered is the governed one WITHOUT naming a stage in a Flow condition - the same property that keeps Lifecycle_Transition__mdt the single definition of an allowed transition. A blank or inactive policy means no qualification requirement applies and MQL entry falls back to transition governance alone.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Lead Status value this policy governs.
CustomField.label: Qualified Stage
